subject: skill:review
gist: A reviewer's checks run through greenline check; probes run plainly
reason: The reviewer's brief and the builder's fix rounds run every check of the change's code through greenline check, since the third and fifth families' reviewers ran npm test and plain node outside it and the record held no fact.

authorisedBy.words: The operator's card of 2026-10-15 on the QA series, "One fix job after the fifth family", with the delegation of 2026-10-16 whose words finalise the fix job's slices: every check of a change's code, a reviewer's and a verifier's included, runs through greenline check, a plain test command proving nothing to the record; a recorded check fact is never removed or edited, a probe recorded by mistake being marked with greenline check --probe; the close writes its terms and decisions before the checks' last run and ends with greenline tidy in every mode; the change's first commit carries its record; and verify's baseline runs on a copy, never over the change's working tree

ruling.words: The operator's ruling R22 of 2026-10-08 on the re-cut brief, "yes amend, with one change": the roster table's names stand, review and verify among them, and control-cli and control-ui become reference files of verify

The operator's rulings of 2026-10-08 on the intake R3 ("yes go ahead" and "everything is good"): interrogate, thermo-nuclear-review, requesting-code-review, receiving-code-review, ponytail-audit and no-comments combine into review, and the contradictions stand as recommended: the reports keep each finding as written and the builder's judgment filters and decides (contradiction 6), severity is review-lens's rungs (7), the pass stays bounded (8), an issue with the plan itself is a finding at the advisory rung (9) and the reviewer does not praise the code (10); within pstack, premature abstraction being worse than duplication wins over its helper-extraction line; ponytail-audit's whole-tree grep enters the excess lens as a default correction of grep every caller; thermo-nuclear-code-quality-review, review-and-ship and deslop stay declined, and code-review-and-quality is garden's

The operator's ruling R21 of 2026-10-08 on orchestration ("orchestration related skills ... have be re thought in to being usable on all harnesses") and the R3 ruling of that day, "yes go ahead", on the portable forms: review's independent reviewers run one after another, each a fresh agent started through the harness's delegation where the mode spends one, inline by the builder at fast, with no parallel axes and no forked turns; interrogate's single-message dispatch, model table and model diversity are dropped; thermo-nuclear-review's BugBot step is dropped, the change's own review reports being what a reviewer reads after its own pass; requesting-code-review's template becomes the brief the review step's agent reads, its dispatch syntax and worktree option dropped; no-comments' agent file becomes a reference passage the excess lens reads, with no agent of its own and its persona voice dropped; browser-testing-with-devtools' security core is restated for any browser an agent drives, its DevTools setup garden's

The operator's rulings of 2026-10-04, "cool then lock everything in": a step runs at the depth the change's mode gives it, inline being one line of its section, written a section the builder writes, independent a fresh agent's report the record cites and looped that pass repeated until clean up to the mode's rounds, clean for review meaning no finding at a blocking rung and for verify every item verified, and a step's handoff names the next step of the change's mode
